documentation.content: The daily pipeline job failed a task attempt. This alert watches the INFRASTRUCTURE, not the app: it fires even when the run never got far enough to reach the database or the ntfy channel (OOM, timeout, crash on start, image pull failure, non-zero exit). That independence is the whole point — the in-app failure nudge cannot report its own delivery path being down. Look at: Cloud Run > Jobs > goal-a-daily > Logs, and the pipeline_runs table for per-stage summaries.

conditions.displayName: a failed task attempt in the last 5 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "goal-a-daily" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_task_attempt_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed"
